scope: All four named real-Jev diagnostic batches, including the unsuccessful meal-coherence hypothesis. Incidents disabled, no onchain save, no cherry-picked rerun of a batch, no manually sampled choice probabilities. Costs are for these batches only.
schema: Each case has one candidateCatalog keyed by the exact offered option key; decision.offered lists its actual menu keys. No provider request bodies or full receipt snapshots are copied.
limitations: Only three matched birth-seed profiles and two evolving days per new-policy trajectory; not population-level diversity or survival evidence.
The baseline already selected three distinct matched main projects.
New-policy day-three resources, house, inclination and bounded memory change together; differences do not isolate a causal memory effect.
Previous-day memory contains bounded executed non-T01 records, not a complete biography or every ordinary choice.
A repeated free near-full-energy late nap may be an unhurried habit, not a safety defect.
R3 is a maker-only context check and did not change the toast-before-bowl behavior.
Provider probabilities and confidence are recorded telemetry, not calibrated guarantees; choices are not resampled.
Latency values are individual provider-call observations, not end-to-end hosted-worker benchmarks.
